common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for round weather display, matching the soft 3D boy in reference images, but NOT a UI screenshot. Create one perfectly regular atlas, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows of square cells, edge-to-edge without gutters, borders or labels, landscape 4:3. Each cell same solid near-black #07090B background, no circle, no device frame, NO letters, numbers, icons, weather particles, scenery or watermarks anywhere. In EVERY cell, one front-facing full-body boy (cute soft clay 3D, same friendly face, big eyes), centered x50%, top of hair y21%, soles y80%, identical scale/pose with arms slightly out so clothes visible, soft studio lighting. Reserve top20% and bottom20% of EACH cell completely empty black for separate runtime UI. Cells numbered conceptually left-to-right top-to-bottom 1..12: cells1..6 boy with brown hair/brown eyes; cells7..12 SAME boy but honey-blond hair and hazel green-brown eyes. Temperature clothing sequence for each identity: 1 hot >=28C, 2 warm22..28C, 3 mild16..22C, 4 cool10..16C, 5 cold0..10C, 6 freezingbelow0C. No printed numbers. Must have EXACTLY 12 complete figures, each fully inside its own equal square. Character reference identities only: maintain face/hair/clay rendering.
